name: Build It Yourself
description: Design a two-subnet network from an empty canvas.
brief:
No starting topology this time. Build a routed network from nothing:

  • 172.16.1.0/24 with PC-01, on Switch-01
  • 172.16.2.0/24 with Server-01, on Switch-02
  • Router-01 with an address on each network

Wire it, address it, set the gateways, and make PC-01 reach Server-01.
hints: A router interface is the gateway for the subnet it sits in.
Configure each router interface in the Interfaces panel.
Check your work with 'show ip route' — two connected routes appear.
